name: Addison Keller Springs

ordinances.description: Change Zoning from Commercial-2 (C-2) to Planned Development (PD)
To provide for revised development plans for a project of 353 multi-family units
The abandonment of the Town's interest in a portion of non-exclusive utility easement

uses.name: Dwelling, multifamily
uses.quote: apartment, condominium, and all uses allowed in the LR

notes: Development must follow the development plans attached to ordinances 006-047 and 011-044.

notes.heading: Fire lanes
items: The fire lanes on the east side and along the south property line must sit flush against the property line, with the trees on the west side of the east lane, in front of the units.
The fire lanes must be built so they can later become R-streets or mews streets.
Fire hydrants every 300 feet along the fire lane.

history.006-047: Rezoned from Commercial-2 to PD for apartments, condominiums and local retail uses
history.011-044: Approved revised plans for Keller Springs Lofts, 353 multifamily units
history.011-056: Abandoned part of the Town's utility easement
